g.text: Has it been more than 2 hours since the last feeding or milk,
or signs of hunger such as sticking out tongue, searching for the breast, shaking head?
Perform abdominal massage or stimulate the anus to encourage a bowel movement
Is there straining or groaning, a distended belly?
Is the baby trying to keep the airway open by tucking their chin?
Is the baby sucking on their fingers?
Adjust clothes and diaper to be comfortable
Check if the baby’s nose is blocked, or if hair or threads are tightly wrapped around the body
Gently scratch or massage the head, belly, or feet
Shake a rattle (rattle toy) to move the head or eye gaze
Adjust clothing based on temperature (20-23°C in winter, 26-28°C in summer), and increase humidity
(If not done yet) Swaddle the baby with a cloth
Is the baby’s temperature above 38.0°C or below 36.0°C, and doesn’t return to normal with changes in clothing?
Is there continuous vomiting or change in breathing?
Walk for 5 minutes and sit for 5-8 minutes (transport response).
Walk fast, perform squats, or jumping jacks.
Change the baby’s holding position (vertical/horizontal), angle
Play white noise, fetal sounds, rain sounds, heartbeat sounds, dryer sounds,
vacuum cleaner sound, ventilation fan sounds, car engine sounds (VTEC sound, HONDA SOUND SITTER),
Takamoto Piano CM, Demaekan CM, Poison, Kafka-kun, Noh chanting, poetry singing,
Tomato-chan sound, baseball cheering sounds (jet balloon sounds) via Youtube or a smart speaker
Sing lullabies (e.g., "Kotorin no uta", "Yurikago no uta", Schubert’s lullaby)
Blow air on the baby’s face or fan with a hand fan
